references.text: The same expression 'when you come into the land' is used regarding God's promise to give the land of Canaan to the children of Israel.
A similar formulation about coming into the land that the Lord gives them, in connection with laws concerning harvest offerings.
Moses speaks to the children of Israel about when they come into the land that the Lord gives them.
Laws and regulations that are to be kept in the land the Lord gives them to live in.
The same pattern: 'When you come into the land that the Lord your God gives you'.
The expression 'when you come into the land that the Lord your God gives you as an inheritance' is repeated.
The fulfillment of the promise to come into the land that the Lord gives to the children of Israel.
Description of the borders of the land that the Lord gives to the children of Israel as an inheritance.
